title: Chinese Investors Pour $188M Into Digital Yuan Firms After PBOC Allows Wallet Interest
summary: Digital Yuan policy has shifted after PBOC has allowed wallet balances to earn interest, prompting $188M inflows into CBDC-linked stocks. Officials have reported scam attempts via fake apps, while usage has reached 3.48B transactions worth 16.7T yuan by Nov 2025. It has supported 230M wallets total.
